title: Effect-native runtime patterns and lint enforcement tasks
principles: Decode unknown input once at ingress with the owning Effect Schema, pass Contract.Type, and encode Contract.Encoded only at egress.
Use strict but pragmatic Effect code: flat, linear, sequential, lazy, composable, and explicit about absence and failure.
Choose time, state, collection, Layer, and optionality primitives by owned semantics rather than API-count goals.
Extend Bundjil's existing Oxlint plugin, Effect language service, and boundary audit; do not add another lint runner or wrapper.
Every lint rule requires one AST invariant, exact ownership, positive and negative unit plus installed-plugin fixtures, a false-positive matrix, migration, and safe autofix decision.
Do not create pass-through services, generic collection transforms, DTO mirrors, manual readers, unsafe casts, or helper/common/utils sprawl.
Run one mandatory five-pass audit only after both implementation ledgers are otherwise complete.

acceptedFindings.decision: Add narrow time and timer lint and migrate only Effect-clock-owned tests; preserve exact live host proof.
Add scoped async/await confinement and object-form Effect.tryPromise rejection mapping.
Add one import-aware runtime execution ownership rule and reject a duplicate second rule.
Use state transition and collection semantic evidence rather than Ref adjacency, native collection, index, or helper-name lint.
Copy or adapt four exact Site rules and explicitly classify every other Site Effect rule.
Pin implementation decisions to lock-resolved Effect beta.101 and reopen research on dependency change.
Sequence implementation after the actual Eve runtime integration state and preserve completed branch proof.

Close typed error channels by removing arbitrary defect causes from exported tagged-error Schemas, enforcing the diagnostic boundary, and replacing a validated-but-impossible adoption-manifest defect with its owning typed failure.

Correct report-only infrastructure drift identity provenance by separating static authority-policy custody from dynamic branded GitHub run identity and carrying the decoded manifest digest through the report and receipt.

lintRules.astInvariant: In configured Effect-owned source and tests, reject Date.now, zero-argument new Date, global or node:timers/node:timers/promises setTimeout and setInterval, and Bun.sleep; in @effect/vitest tests also reject exact TestClock.withLive time escapes unless the exact host-boundary owner is registered.

lintRules.migration: Use fixed decoded epochs or Clock/TestClock; register exact path/symbol host proof with owner, reason, observable, and removal trigger.

lintRules.astInvariant: Reject async functions, await, and new Promise in configured Effect service source unless the function is the direct Effect.promise callback or the try callback of object-form Effect.tryPromise.

lintRules.astInvariant: Import-aware Effect.tryPromise calls require one object expression containing both try and catch.
lintRules.scopeOwner: lint/oxlint-plugin.ts across app/package production and boundary-model tests
positiveFixtures: namespace and direct import object form with try and catch
negativeFixtures: aliased direct import bare function overload
lintRules.falsePositiveRisk: A genuinely infallible Promise boundary using the wrong Effect constructor.
lintRules.migration: Use Effect.promise only for documented infallibility or add the owner safe tagged error.

lintRules.astInvariant: Import-aware Effect.runPromise, runPromiseExit, runFork, runSync, runSyncExit, ManagedRuntime.make, and BunRuntime.runMain calls fail outside exact app runtime, main, server, CLI, script, test, and registered framework adapter owners.

tasks.title: Review and migrate only evidence-backed state and collection targets
tasks.description: Apply the decision matrix to the refreshed state/collection corpus, preserving clear current exemplars and changing only targets with demonstrated atomicity, lifetime, equality, absence, cardinality, order, or persistent-sequence value.
implementationNotes: Use one immutable state record when a transition table proves shared atomic invariants; keep independently owned Refs separate.

Use Ref for pure atomic transitions, SynchronizedRef for required serialized/effectful transitions, SubscriptionRef for real streams, ScopedRef for replaceable resources, and Context.Reference for v4 dynamically scoped defaults.
Do not introduce Atom or @effect-atom into backend/runtime code.
Use Schema.NonEmptyArray only for at-least-one contracts; use tuples/checks for exact cardinality and preserve legitimately empty arrays.
Use HashMap/HashSet only where immutable update, Equal/Hash, typed absence, or set algebra is materially useful; preserve native collection owners and deterministic ordering contracts.
Use Chunk only for measured persistent concatenation or a native API owner.
Keep Option, decoded optional fields, Option.match, Match, and ordinary if composition in their distinct domains.

Keep the Upstash SDK rejection cause only in its private adapter error and collapse it to the existing safe public KeyValueStore errors.
Add the public-raw-cause provenance rule with direct required, optional, and renamed-field Schema.Defect negative fixtures; do not add exceptions or another checker.
Replace the unreachable Effect.die after Photon cardinality validation with the same capability-owned AdoptionManifestBuildError so later control-flow changes cannot escape the declared channel.

proofContract.directObservable: The production-source Schema.Defect scan is empty; the boundary audit rejects required, optional, and renamed exported defect fields; encoded error fixtures omit arbitrary causes; the adoption scope has no production Effect.die; Eve 7, Codex 115, proxy 41, boundary 124, and infrastructure owner tests pass.

proofContract.falseGreenRejected: Changing only log rendering, making cause optional, retaining Schema.Defect under another exported field, preserving an impossible die after validation, or passing typecheck without encoded-contract fixtures.
proofContract.focusedCommandOrProcedureOwner: Eve, Codex, codex-proxy, boundary provenance, Effect setup, docs, and root verification owners
proofContract.limitationsAndNonClaims: Repository proof does not establish provider behavior or remove private causes before their safe public mapping.

completionCriteria: No exported production tagged-error Schema contains Schema.Defect.
The provenance rule has direct required, optional, and renamed-field negative fixtures and no exception.

Canonical Effect guidance, task ledger, active plan, focused tests, bun run verification, and git diff --check agree.
